subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should an existing `IDENTITY.md` or explicit `--identity-file` above 2 MiB become a hard rejected input, rather than preserving the former unbounded-read behavior?
rationale: The shared cap is a sensible anti-OOM boundary, but it intentionally changes the acceptance contract for already-existing large identity files and causes the explicit CLI path to stop before config writes.

options.title: Accept the shared 2 MiB contract
options.body: Land the bounded-reader approach after current-head proof confirms normal files still import and cap-plus-one files fail with the intended diagnostic.

options.title: Preserve large explicit imports
options.body: Keep workspace bootstrap reads bounded but choose a separately reviewed import path or format policy if existing explicit identity files above 2 MiB must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared 2 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Land the bounded-reader approach after current-head proof confirms normal files still import and cap-plus-one files fail with the intended diagnostic.
